entries.name: Ambush Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ambush.

entries.name: Ambush Beacon
entries.ruleText: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

entries.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

entries.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

entries.name: Armor
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Defense X+.

entries.name: Bane in Melee Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Bane in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Battleborn
entries.ruleText: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Bounding Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bounding.

entries.name: Caster Group
entries.ruleText: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.

entries.name: Darkborn
entries.ruleText: Enemies get -4" range to a min. of 6" when trying to shoot at units where all models have this rule, and -2" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule.

entries.name: Dash Aura

entries.name: Defensive Frenzy
entries.ruleText: If all models in this unit have this rule, place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls until the end of the game.

entries.name: Extended Buff Range
entries.ruleText: If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that has a Hero in it, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

entries.name: Fanatic

entries.name: Mobile Artillery
entries.ruleText: When this model uses a Hold action and shoots at enemies over 9" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. As long this model hasn't moved during the round, when enemy units shoot at it from over 9" away, they get -2 to hit rolls.

entries.name: No Retreat
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

entries.name: Piercing Spotter

When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Piercing Tag
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

entries.name: Reinforcement
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken or fully destroyed, you may remove it from the table as destroyed and place a new copy of it fully within 12" of any table edge at the beginning of the next round after Ambushers have been deployed. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

entries.name: Spell Accumulator
entries.ruleText: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Spell Conduit
entries.ruleText: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Split
entries.ruleText: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model.

entries.name: Takedown Strike
